summary.name: Zettlr
summary.one_liner: Zettlr is an open-source Markdown editor for authoring, organizing, and exporting documents, aimed at researchers, journalists, and writers.
use_cases: organizing notes and to-do items while writing
exporting documents for different publication pipelines
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Zettlr as a Markdown document authoring tool for researchers, journalists, and writers. It claims the app helps users organize notes, keep track of to-do items, and monitor writing progress. It lists fast information retrieval for finding relevant content and tools for tracking the journal submission process. It also advertises versatile exporting intended to fit different publication pipelines. The page is mostly marketing copy and gives few concrete technical details.
notable: Markdown-based publication workbench for researchers, journalists, and writers
Tools for tracking the journal submission process
Versatile exporting for different publication pipelines
Listed as open-source and freeware on awesome-mac lists
caveats: The page itself gives little detail on features or limits
Platform support beyond macOS is not stated on the page text
